use_case_summary: LucidWave runs enterprise BPO support for retail clients. They need post-call summarization (TL;DR for ticket creation), automated QA scoring and coaching highlights for supervisors, and a tool-calling layer that can recommend and trigger Zendesk macros. Key success metrics: reduction in QA review time by 60%, faster coaching cycles, and maintain avg response generation p95 < 500ms under normal load, graceful degradation under 6x spikes.
technical_requirements: Latency target: p95 generation < 500ms for 3-sentence TL;DR
Throughput target: support sustained 200 rps during peak, spike to 1200 rps tolerable with queuing/fallback
Model preferences: open model variants with quantized weights; ability to route to smaller fallback model when cost-constrained
Integration: Zendesk (REST + webhooks), S3 transcript ingestion, KMS for encryption at rest
Observability: token-level cost breakdown, per-call trace and rollout flags, per-model latency dashboards
Retention: per-customer retention policy; ability to purge PII on request within 7 days
poc_results_summary: Quality: TL;DR median ROUGE-L acceptable for managers but edge cases for multi-party calls
Latency: average generation 320ms, p95 490ms under POC load; spikes caused by transient GPU saturation
Cost: estimated hosted running cost crossed threshold; suggested Dedicated/quantization for targets
Reliability: fallback model preserved availability during 3 simulated spike tests
